description: Creates a new node in a Cognigy.AI flow. MUTATING: This modifies the flow. Use dryRun=true (default) to validate first. Nodes are the building blocks of conversation logic (Say, Question, If, Code, etc.).

config.description: Node-specific configuration object. Structure depends on node type.

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates the operation without creating the node. Set to false to actually create.

extension.description: Extension ID if this is a custom extension node

flowId.description: The flow ID where the node will be created

label.description: Display label for the node in the flow editor

mode.description: How to position the new node relative to target: append (after), prepend (before), appendChild/prependChild (as child), insertChildAt (at position), insertAfter, insertBefore

position.description: Position index when using insertChildAt mode

targetNodeId.description: The ID of the target node relative to which this node will be positioned

type.description: Node type (e.g., 'say', 'question', 'if', 'code', 'executeFlow'). Use get_node_descriptors to list available types.

name: create_node
